items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was sitting up playing my vibraphones with Dick Wilson with a towel wrapped around... And he came to me; I said, 'I'm Jo Jones and this is Dick Wilson.'

ctx.x: I know you know him much better and much longer than I. I just have to ask you to say whatever you would about Mr. John Hammond. Walk around or do anything you want, but I want this like Jo Jones wants to say it.

I wouldn't go into infancy years. John Hammond; my name is Jonathan, so is his. You must remember he's coming through a period with another fellow, name of Charlie Barnet. I remember Basie getting a letter from Charlie Barnet and from John Hammond at the same time. I read both of the letters and I said, "You read the one; answer John's." Because Buck Clayton had just come back from China and he was in California. He was on his way to join us. We had no job for Buck, because Buck came in to Kansas City and he…
A white man come into a black hotel?
